values.note: $20 a night for a site without electric, Thursday-Saturday $23; electric $33, Thursday-Saturday $40. Horsemen's sites not counted. No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). Indiana's rate page gives only statewide ranges; these are the booking site's prices for April 2027 nights, read 2026-10-31.

note: Family campground. 200-acre Whitewater Lake is reached via the ~1-mile Cattail Alley Trail; campground is not lakefront. Horsemen's camp is separate. --Claude
